expected.page: You're late, Traveller. The tide has already turned.
expected.plain: You're late, Traveller. The tide has already turned.

expected.page: Beyond the harbour, a single light flickers in the mist.
expected.plain: Beyond the harbour, a single light flickers in the mist.

expected.page: A ferryman's coin? I haven't seen one of these since I was a child.
expected.plain: A ferryman's coin? I haven't seen one of these since I was a child.

expected.page: Thank you. Perhaps I was wrong about you.
expected.plain: Thank you. Perhaps I was wrong about you.

expected.page: The keeper vanished three nights ago. No footprints. No boat. Just the light, still burning.
expected.plain: The keeper vanished three nights ago. No footprints. No boat. Just the light, still burning.

expected.page: I think you can help me find him.
expected.plain: I think you can help me find him.

expected.page: Then meet me at the old jetty at dawn.
expected.plain: Then meet me at the old jetty at dawn.

expected.page: And whatever you do… don't follow the light alone.
expected.plain: And whatever you do… don't follow the light alone.
